Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```python title="Python"
from xberg import ocr_backend_supports_language
from xberg import XbergError

def main() -> None:
    try:
        backend = "nonexistent-backend-xyz"
        language = "eng"
        ocr_backend_supports_language(backend, language)
    except XbergError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

main()
```
